decisions.reason: As a flagship launch in a growing cloud communications market, it is strategically central, still early in its option life, and inexpensive relative to its potential upside to keep on the market.

It extends electronic document workflows and may need more time to prove demand, so the firm would likely keep the option open while learning, despite it being somewhat less core than messaging transport.

Because it supports multichannel business communication and regulated-process customers, the service fits the existing platform and likely has low enough carrying cost to justify continued market presence.
Although fax-related offerings are more niche and this is only an optimization feature, it complements the installed base and can be retained cheaply while the firm observes ongoing customer need.

Threat protection is closely aligned with the firm's secure messaging proposition, and uncertainty about full uptake is not yet sufficient to justify abandoning it after only a short time on the market.

Multi-engine virus scanning strengthens the core secure email offering and is the kind of modular software option a German B2B communications provider would usually keep while demand and bundling potential continue to develop.
